## When to use it

Edit drafts into clearer, sharper, more human prose while preserving the writer's meaning and personal voice, or audit prose for specific AI-slop patterns without rewriting it. Use for general writing, line editing, clarity and voice revisions, concision, directness, AI-sounding prose, or requests to detect whether writing reads like AI.

Example request:

> Use general-writing to improve this work using its complete upstream guidance.

Expected result: An output shaped by the complete upstream instructions, source material and the task at hand.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill general-writing
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/general-writing/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/general-writing/references/GEEKIST-UPSTREAM.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
